name: Lagertorwiese
beschreibung: The nature campsite Lagertorwiese enjoys an exceptionally quiet and sunny rural setting on the outskirts of Going am Wilden Kaiser. Nestled right at the foot of the dramatic Wilder Kaiser mountain chain, it offers outdoor enthusiasts an authentic and relaxing alpine stay. The grounds feature well-tended pitches for motorhomes and caravans alongside open grassy meadow areas for camping tents. Practical facilities include clean restrooms and showers, electrical hookups, and a small convenience shop for daily essentials. In summer, the site is an ideal starting base for hikes and climbing routes in the Kaiser range, with SkiWelt ski slopes nearby in winter.
kurzbeschreibung: Peaceful alpine nature campsite in Going am Wilden Kaiser offering picturesque views of the Wilder Kaiser.
